Match Preview and Team Form

The Spain U20 team is the reigning U-19 European champion and one of the main contenders to win the World Cup. Its squad is packed with future stars of world football from the academies of Barcelona, Real Madrid, and other top clubs. The Spanish rely on their signature 'tiki-taka' style, based on total ball control and combination play.

The Colombia U20 team is traditionally one of the strongest on its continent. 'Los Cafeteros' are known for their technical, attacking football and the individual skill of their players. Bookmakers consider the Spanish team the favorites. Their superior class, tactical discipline, and successful head-to-head record favor the European side. However, the technical and unpredictable style of the Colombians could cause them serious problems.

Join us for the live broadcast of a Latin American super derby in the FIFA U-20 World Cup group stage, as the Mexico U20 team faces six-time world champions Argentina. This clash between two football nations with rich histories promises to be spectacular.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 12, 2025, 23:00 UTC (October 11).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Mexico U20 team is one of the most decorated in the CONCACAF region and globally. 'El Tri' relies on fast, combination-based football and the individual skill of its attacking players. Mexico enters the tournament as a 'dark horse' and will aim to prove themselves against the main group favorite.

The Argentina U20 team, the most decorated in tournament history, is one of the main title contenders. The 'Albiceleste' are known for their technical football and abundance of highly talented players. After a poor previous result, a victory in this match is essential for Argentina to advance from the group.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

The teams met in the quarter-finals of the 2011 FIFA U-20 World Cup, where Mexico won 3-1. They also played in the 2017 group stage, with Mexico winning 3-0. Statistics indicate that Mexico is a very tricky opponent for Argentina at the youth level.

Mexico U20 vs Argentina U20 Prediction

Despite the unfavorable head-to-head record, Argentina are considered favorites. Their technical superiority and higher player class favor the 'Albiceleste.' However, Mexico's resilience and past successes make them a dangerous opponent.
